text:
oliver: Hey — first week here. Trying to set up alerting on a Redwood Console dashboard (per-route latency) but I don’t see the Alerts tab/permissions. Also my Sentry project for our private deployment is missing. Who should I ping for Grafana/Grafana alert routing + Sentry DSN access?

devex-bot: Hi Oliver — quick checklist: 1) request Grafana folder access 2) ask infra to add you to eng-observability group 3) provide Sentry project slug for private mapping docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/obs-onboarding :robot_face:

anya: Hey @oliver — I can help with Grafana side. For alerts you need folder-level edit + Alerting role. If you paste the dashboard UID I can check. To find UID: Dashboards -> share -> Link contains uid=XXXX.

kevin: Adding detail: we use alert routing rules that map folder -> slack channel -> pager policy. If you create alerts under the folder we can auto-route. Example minimal curl to create a folder (replace token):
```
curl -s -X POST https://grafana.redwood.internal/api/folders \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAF_TOKEN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"title":"team-oliver","uid":"team-oliver"}'
```
After folder exists, set alert rules in the folder and tag with `team:oliver`. I'll add the routing once I see the tag.

sara: For Sentry on Private: we don't auto-create projects. You need to request a project slug and environment mapping. Please open an infra ticket with: 1) org email domain 2) desired project slug (e.g., redwood-private-oliver) 3) service name and expected envs (prod/staging). We'll return the DSN and add it to the private deploys mapping.

oliver: Thanks all — dashboard UID is `XyZ12abc`. Filing the infra ticket now with the info you asked for, @sara.

kevin: Cool — once infra confirms I’ll subscribe the folder to `#team-oliver-alerts` and wire the escalation policy. If you want a test alert flow I can trigger one.

oliver: That would be great, thanks. Also, do I need a special Grafana token or can I use the web UI?

anya: Web UI is fine if you have folder edit. If you hit API for automation use a service token scoped to `dashboards:write` and `folders:write`.

devex-bot: Tip: for the infra ticket use template `obs-access-request` to expedite. Link: https://redwood.internal/infra/tickets/new?template=obs-access-request

oliver: Filed the ticket with project slug `redwood-private-oliver` and linked the dashboard UID. Pulling a sample alert together and will paste it here for review. Thanks everyone :heart:

kevin: ack — ping me when the ticket is in. I’ll watch the routing change. :thumbsup:
